"""Database models for the Django News Application.

Defines publishers, users, articles, and newsletters.

The custom user model supports reader, journalist, and editor roles.
Readers can subscribe to publishers and individual journalists.
Articles support editorial approval before publication.
"""

from django.contrib.auth.models import AbstractUser
from django.db import models




[docs]
class Publisher(models.Model):
    """
    Represents a curated news publication.
    """

    name = models.CharField(
        max_length=255,
        unique=True,
    )

    description = models.TextField(
        blank=True,
    )

    created_at = models.DateTimeField(
        auto_now_add=True,
    )

    # Publishers can have multiple editors.
    editors = models.ManyToManyField(
        "CustomUser",
        blank=True,
        related_name="managed_publishers",
        limit_choices_to={"role": "editor"},
    )

    # Publishers can have multiple journalists.
    journalists = models.ManyToManyField(
        "CustomUser",
        blank=True,
        related_name="publisher_affiliations",
        limit_choices_to={"role": "journalist"},
    )

    def __str__(self):
        return self.name

class CustomUser(AbstractUser):
    """
    Custom user model with the three required roles:

    - Reader
    - Journalist
    - Editor
    """

    ROLE_READER = "reader"
    ROLE_JOURNALIST = "journalist"
    ROLE_EDITOR = "editor"

    ROLE_CHOICES = [
        (ROLE_READER, "Reader"),
        (ROLE_JOURNALIST, "Journalist"),
        (ROLE_EDITOR, "Editor"),
    ]

    role = models.CharField(
        max_length=20,
        choices=ROLE_CHOICES,
        default=ROLE_READER,
    )

    requested_role = models.CharField(
        max_length=20,
        choices=ROLE_CHOICES,
        default=ROLE_READER,
        help_text="Role requested during registration.",
    )

    # Reader subscriptions to publishers.
    subscriptions_publishers = models.ManyToManyField(
        Publisher,
        blank=True,
        related_name="subscribers",
    )

    # Reader subscriptions to individual journalists.
    subscriptions_journalists = models.ManyToManyField(
        "self",
        symmetrical=False,
        blank=True,
        related_name="journalist_subscribers",
        limit_choices_to={"role": "journalist"},
    )

    def __str__(self):
        return self.username

    @property
    def is_reader(self):
        """Return whether this user has the reader role."""
        return self.role == self.ROLE_READER

    @property
    def is_journalist(self):
        """Return whether this user has the journalist role."""
        return self.role == self.ROLE_JOURNALIST

    @property
    def is_editor(self):
        """Return whether this user has the editor role."""
        return self.role == self.ROLE_EDITOR

class Article(models.Model):
    """
    Represents a news article.

    Articles are written by journalists and can optionally
    belong to a publisher.
    """

    title = models.CharField(
        max_length=255,
    )

    content = models.TextField()

    author = models.ForeignKey(
        CustomUser,
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="authored_articles",
    )

    publisher = models.ForeignKey(
        Publisher,
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        related_name="articles",
    )

    created_at = models.DateTimeField(
        auto_now_add=True,
    )

    approved = models.BooleanField(
        default=False,
    )

    def __str__(self):
        return self.title

class Newsletter(models.Model):
    """
    A curated collection of articles.

    Newsletters can be created by journalists and editors.
    """

    title = models.CharField(
        max_length=255,
    )

    description = models.TextField()

    created_at = models.DateTimeField(
        auto_now_add=True,
    )

    author = models.ForeignKey(
        CustomUser,
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name="authored_newsletters",
    )

    articles = models.ManyToManyField(
        Article,
        related_name="newsletters",
        blank=True,
    )

    def __str__(self):
        return self.title
